cases.title: Late hit
cases.where: Lornaman Renegades at Purcell Rapids, week 19
cases.text:
Corentin Fonmont (TE, Renegades) was flagged for unnecessary roughness with 5:46 left in the first quarter on a hit the officials ruled came well after the play was over. Radoslav Oikonomides (S, Rapids) left for a few plays and returned. Fonmont sought out Oikonomides after the game to apologize. The league's film review found the contact was avoidable.

Corentin Fonmont's agent, Harlan Quist, says the player will cooperate with the review.
